//: nodeModulesDir 'auto' is the load-bearing line. supabase-js is an npm
package, and Deno only resolves npm: specifiers through the global cache
when nothing upstream puts it into node-resolution mode. A package.json
anywhere above the checkout is enough to flip that, and then `deno run`
fails with 'could not find a matching package in the node_modules
directory' even though `deno check` was perfectly happy.
Setting it here makes the behaviour the same on every machine: Deno
creates a local node_modules under supabase/seed and installs into it.
The Edge Function deliberately has no config of its own. It runs on
Supabase's edge runtime, which resolves npm: specifiers natively, and
